newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's FIEL postpones data releases to Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's FIEL postpones data releases to Feb 24.

text.p: Argentine private consultants FIEL said Wednesday they would delay the release of December's industrial production index, expected later this week, because their staff was away on summer holidays.
"On Monday, February 24 FIEL will publish the index for December and the preliminary index for January," a FIEL spokesman told Reuters.
The government's official December industrial output data was expected January 23.
